show_notes.title: EARLY Week 9 Waiver Wire TARGETS! Washington Jr., Nix, Lemon, Okonkwo & More! (FFT Express)
show_notes.text:
**Sleeper MAIN, Taylor Snift.** QBs Mahomes and Josh Allen are fine. Adam's "drop Hampton for Coleman" line is aimed at your guy, but Coleman isn't available here. Mine: Hampton's W8 was 4.7 PPR, and if you need an RB body, Gainwell (FA, 14.0 PPR, 25-140) and Mike Washington Jr. (FA, 25 carries) are the free-agent RBs on Jamey's list. You hold Jonathan Taylor; Jamey's McGowan and Giddens talk depends on a JT trade, so watch the news before the deadline. TE: you have LaPorta, so Gesicki is just bye/injury insurance. Montgomery is Out and Davante Adams is on IR. The steady WR3s Jamey named (Shakir, Malik Washington, Flournoy) are already rostered in MAIN, but Adonai Mitchell (27.2 PPR in W8) and Malachi Fields are free agents.

**Sleeper DYNASTY, Amon A Boat!.** Willis is yours and is Jamey's top QB pickup, so keep him. Rodgers is on the PIT bye in Wk9, so your QB room is Daniels, Lawrence and Willis. Daniels took a shot from Adam for "uncharacteristically inaccurate" throws on SNF, though WAS won 27-10. Tyler Warren (yours) isn't mentioned. Most of the guys named are rostered in DYN; Minshew, Geno Smith, Kirk Cousins, Murray, Wentz, McKee and Giddens are free agents if you want QB depth.

**Yahoo HE-MAN'S HEROES, The Cook King Show (193237).** ⚠️ Yahoo files are stale (last pulled 10/25, Week 7), so free-agent status is unknown. From that roster: Jordyn Tyson is on your bench at IR, and Jamey says he could practice in Wk9, so hold him. Rashid Shaheed was Out; if he still is, Antonio Williams, Lemon or Flournoy are the WR adds to check on Yahoo. Baker Mayfield backs up Mahomes. Check Jonah Coleman's status in this league.

**Yahoo SUPERFLEX, Jackson My Penix (193255).** ⚠️ Same stale-file caveat. Lamar is on IR (thumb surgery), so your QBs are Mayfield and Penix. Jamey's superflex adds: Minshew (ARI starter guess) and Wentz (Murray hamstring). Ryan Flournoy is on your bench and has 11+ PPR in four straight (W5–W8, confirmed on Sleeper), so he's a legit flex. DeVonta Smith is on your bench and Out; Adam says his return ends Lemon's value. Justin Jefferson is yours; Adam says he's "not happy right now" and Murray has a hamstring issue.

**Freddy.** In MAIN (Flowers for Ms. Jackson), his QBs are Lamar (Out) and Rodgers (PIT bye), so he needs a QB. Willis, Nix, Minshew, Geno, Cousins, Murray and Wentz are all free agents in MAIN. Mine: claim one yourself only if you want to block him, since you're set at QB. He has Antonio Williams and JAX D/ST. In DYN (The Man in Jahmyr), Jamey praised two of his RBs, Emmett Johnson ("all leagues") and Dylan Sampson; Deebo Samuel is Out.

show_notes.title: Week 8 Winners & Losers: Biggest Takeaways From Every Game! | 2026 Fantasy Football Advice
show_notes.text:
*Sleeper as of Mon 9:05 AM ET; only CHI@SEA is left. **Yahoo files are stale (fetched 10/25)**, so the Yahoo notes below use that snapshot and could be wrong if you've moved players since.*
- **Sleeper MAIN (Taylor Snift): lost 131.05 to 193.05** (your opponent's Caleb Williams plays tonight, but it doesn't matter). **Jonathan Taylor** (10.2) is the big one: the panel thinks the Colts are "probably trading Taylor." Wherever he lands decides your RB1, and Giddens/McGowan are only flex fill-ins if he goes. **Ollie Gordon** (12.65 in your scoring) had zero catches and a personal foul, and "they just don't throw to him." **Jordan Mason** (4.5) is in a three-back committee and is the likeliest MIN back to be traded (Heath). **LaPorta** (7.25) is a unanimous buy and gets MIA next week, so keep starting him. **Hampton** (6.95) was "third on the team in snap share." Keon Coleman (bench, 1.4) missed a wide-open deep TD. *Mine:* Mahomes scored 39.9 on your bench; the show noted he's been the best QB against DEN this year.
- **Sleeper DYNASTY (Amon A Boat!): you beat Freddy 132.38 to 125.54.** Santos kicks tonight, but Freddy has nobody left. You own **both Jets backs**. Braelon (23.3) won it for you, and Heath expects a heavy split with Breece if Breece isn't traded. **Hockenson 15.8 and Keenan Allen 13.7 outscored Tyler Warren 5.8 again from your bench.** Dave likes Hockenson as a starter, and the panel would only start Taylor if Richardson takes over in Indy. **Ken Walker** (12.4): "no concerns," with NYJ, ATL, ARI, BUF next. **Bowers** (28.2): Adam floated selling before a Mendoza switch, and the others pushed back, so hold. **Malik Willis** (bench, 14.64) is a named streamer. Caleb Douglas (8.3) is getting six targets. Lawrence 19.4 came on just 14 attempts.
- **Yahoo HE-MAN'S HEROES (The Cook King Show)** *(10/25 roster)*: **Derrick Henry** is the worry: Heath and others are "really worried," and BAL has no QB on a short week vs JAX. **Mahomes** was the top QB against DEN; keep him. **Swift and Odunze are on MNF tonight.** McConkey (bench) got bailed out by a lucky 54-yarder. Jacobs had the big week Heath predicted. Ollie Gordon has the same no-targets problem. Baker Mayfield (bench) threw three passes and completed none. Jordyn Tyson (IR) could be back as soon as Week 9 (from the morning show).
- **Yahoo SUPERFLEX (Jackson My Penix)** *(10/25 roster)*: **Penix (2.1, four INTs, "could not hold the ball") and Mayfield (0 completions)** were both bad in the 16-0 game. The panel expects TB to keep running, with CHI and DET next. QB is your biggest Superflex hole: Willis (DYN only, not this league) and Minshew were named as streamers. Judkins (6.9) should rebound vs NO (Dave). Flournoy (bench, 13.1) is a waiver darling who played more snaps than Pickens, so consider him. Jefferson stays a "borderline number one, number two receiver." Waddle scored. Pitts 2.6. Lamar was on IR in the file and now needs surgery.
- **Freddy:** In **MAIN** (Flowers for Ms. Jackson, lost 102.00 to 146.95) he's hurt worst by this episode: **Lamar on IR, Flowers "probably not a starter,"** DK Metcalf a featured loser, Kelce's red-zone role keeps shrinking, and Bijan is a buy-low that won't come cheap (so don't overpay him for Bijan). His JAX DST (26.0) is the panel's league-winner stream for Week 9. In **DYN** (The Man in Jahmyr, lost to you) Fannin (23.4) is Heath's winner, but he left Emmett Johnson 27.3, DeMario Douglas 17.6 and Corum 13.3 on his bench. Bourne has a high ankle sprain, and Corum is "a very good flex."

Daniels took a shot from Adam for "uncharacteristically inaccurate" throws on SNF, though WAS won 27-10. Tyler Warren (yours) isn't mentioned. Most of the guys named are rostered in DYN; Minshew, Geno Smith, Kirk Cousins, Murray, Wentz, McKee and Giddens are free agents if you want QB depth.

**Yahoo HE-MAN'S HEROES, The Cook King Show (193237).** ⚠️ Yahoo files are stale (last pulled 10/25, Week 7), so free-agent status is unknown. From that roster: Jordyn Tyson is on your bench at IR, and Jamey says he could practice in Wk9, so hold him. Rashid Shaheed was Out; if he still is, Antonio Williams, Lemon or Flournoy are the WR adds to check on Yahoo. Baker Mayfield backs up Mahomes. Check Jonah Coleman's status in this league.

Jamey's superflex adds: Minshew (ARI starter guess) and Wentz (Murray hamstring). Ryan Flournoy is on your bench and has 11+ PPR in four straight (W5–W8, confirmed on Sleeper), so he's a legit flex. DeVonta Smith is on your bench and Out; Adam says his return ends Lemon's value. Justin Jefferson is yours; Adam says he's "not happy right now" and Murray has a hamstring issue.

**Freddy.** In MAIN (Flowers for Ms. Jackson), his QBs are Lamar (Out) and Rodgers (PIT bye), so he needs a QB. Willis, Nix, Minshew, Geno, Cousins, Murray and Wentz are all free agents in MAIN. In DYN (The Man in Jahmyr), Jamey praised two of his RBs, Emmett Johnson ("all leagues") and Dylan Sampson; Deebo Samuel is Out.

show_notes.text:
**MAIN LEAGUE: Taylor Snift (Myles High Club, redraft, 2-3; PPR + 0.25 per rush/rec first down)**
- 🚨 **Davante Adams (your starting WR) is out 6-10 weeks** with a ruptured hamstring. **[my check]** Sean McVay announced it Monday (NFL.com, ESPN, AP). The show had "no update" on air. You need a WR replacement now; your IR spots already hold Montgomery and Mason.
- **Free agents in this league the hosts liked:** Jaylin Noel (HOU), Jahan Dotson (ATL), Ryan Flournoy (DAL), Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG), DeMario Douglas (NE). Kyle Pitts is also a free agent here, but he was only referenced indirectly (≈ "Kyle Smith"), not discussed. Stefon Diggs (bench, questionable) plays on MNF tonight, which will tell you whether he can fill the Adams spot.
- **Jalen Coker (your flex):** the most bullish segment of the show for you. He's WR5 per game in healthy games, Jacob ranked him over McMillan, and 31 targets in those 3 games with 5 red-zone looks. **[my check]** Week 6 line: 6-97 on 13 targets (team-leading), 59 of 79 snaps (Panthers.com, Pro-Football-Reference); next is vs TB. Keep starting him. First downs in your scoring reward his volume.
- **David Montgomery (IR):** Adam's Woody Marks love depends on Montgomery staying out. Marks is rostered by Killa Walleye here, so you can't grab the handcuff.
- **Omarion Hampton:** the panel called the Chargers' O-line "horrible," the standard for a bad line. That's a mild drag on his efficiency.
- **Jordan Mason (IR, MIN):** Dan is "pretty much in" on the Vikings offense ROS, a quiet plus when he returns.
- **Mark Andrews / Sam LaPorta:** no direct mention. Kraft (the hosts' TE buy) is rostered by Amon Raw, Next Question.
- **Rams DEF:** **[my check]** the Rams also lost DT Poona Ford (season) and DT Kobie Turner (4-6 weeks), which weakens your DST.

show_notes.title: EARLY Week 9 Waiver Wire TARGETS! Washington Jr., Nix, Lemon, Okonkwo & More! (FFT Express)
show_notes.text:
**Sleeper MAIN, Taylor Snift.** QBs Mahomes and Josh Allen are fine. Adam's "drop Hampton for Coleman" line is aimed at your guy, but Coleman isn't available here. Mine: Hampton's W8 was 4.7 PPR, and if you need an RB body, Gainwell (FA, 14.0 PPR, 25-140) and Mike Washington Jr. (FA, 25 carries) are the free-agent RBs on Jamey's list. You hold Jonathan Taylor; Jamey's McGowan and Giddens talk depends on a JT trade, so watch the news before the deadline. TE: you have LaPorta, so Gesicki is just bye/injury insurance. show_notes.title: EARLY Week 9 Waiver Wire TARGETS! Washington Jr., Nix, Lemon, Okonkwo & More! (FFT Express)
show_notes.text:
**Sleeper MAIN, Taylor Snift.** QBs Mahomes and Josh Allen are fine. Adam's "drop Hampton for Coleman" line is aimed at your guy, but Coleman isn't available here. Mine: Hampton's W8 was 4.7 PPR, and if you need an RB body, Gainwell (FA, 14.0 PPR, 25-140) and Mike Washington Jr. (FA, 25 carries) are the free-agent RBs on Jamey's list. You hold Jonathan Taylor; Jamey's McGowan and Giddens talk depends on a JT trade, so watch the news before the deadline. TE: you have LaPorta, so Gesicki is just bye/injury insurance. Montgomery is Out and Davante Adams is on IR. The steady WR3s Jamey named (Shakir, Malik Washington, Flournoy) are already rostered in MAIN, but Adonai Mitchell (27.2 PPR in W8) and Malachi Fields are free agents.

**Sleeper DYNASTY, Amon A Boat!.** Willis is yours and is Jamey's top QB pickup, so keep him. Rodgers is on the PIT bye in Wk9, so your QB room is Daniels, Lawrence and Willis. Daniels took a shot from Adam for "uncharacteristically inaccurate" throws on SNF, though WAS won 27-10. Tyler Warren (yours) isn't mentioned. Most of the guys named are rostered in DYN; Minshew, Geno Smith, Kirk Cousins, Murray, Wentz, McKee and Giddens are free agents if you want QB depth.

**Yahoo HE-MAN'S HEROES, The Cook King Show (193237).** ⚠️ Yahoo files are stale (last pulled 10/25, Week 7), so free-agent status is unknown. From that roster: Jordyn Tyson is on your bench at IR, and Jamey says he could practice in Wk9, so hold him. Rashid Shaheed was Out; if he still is, Antonio Williams, Lemon or Flournoy are the WR adds to check on Yahoo. Baker Mayfield backs up Mahomes. Check Jonah Coleman's status in this league.

**Yahoo SUPERFLEX, Jackson My Penix (193255).** ⚠️ Same stale-file caveat. Lamar is on IR (thumb surgery), so your QBs are Mayfield and Penix. Jamey's superflex adds: Minshew (ARI starter guess) and Wentz (Murray hamstring). Ryan Flournoy is on your bench and has 11+ PPR in four straight (W5–W8, confirmed on Sleeper), so he's a legit flex. DeVonta Smith is on your bench and Out; Adam says his return ends Lemon's value. Justin Jefferson is yours; Adam says he's "not happy right now" and Murray has a hamstring issue.

**Freddy.** In MAIN (Flowers for Ms. Jackson), his QBs are Lamar (Out) and Rodgers (PIT bye), so he needs a QB. Willis, Nix, Minshew, Geno, Cousins, Murray and Wentz are all free agents in MAIN. Mine: claim one yourself only if you want to block him, since you're set at QB. He has Antonio Williams and JAX D/ST. In DYN (The Man in Jahmyr), Jamey praised two of his RBs, Emmett Johnson ("all leagues") and Dylan Sampson; Deebo Samuel is Out.

show_notes.title: Week 8 Winners & Losers: Biggest Takeaways From Every Game! | 2026 Fantasy Football Advice
show_notes.text:
*Sleeper as of Mon 9:05 AM ET; only CHI@SEA is left. **Yahoo files are stale (fetched 10/25)**, so the Yahoo notes below use that snapshot and could be wrong if you've moved players since.*
- **Sleeper MAIN (Taylor Snift): lost 131.05 to 193.05** (your opponent's Caleb Williams plays tonight, but it doesn't matter). **Jonathan Taylor** (10.2) is the big one: the panel thinks the Colts are "probably trading Taylor." Wherever he lands decides your RB1, and Giddens/McGowan are only flex fill-ins if he goes. **Ollie Gordon** (12.65 in your scoring) had zero catches and a personal foul, and "they just don't throw to him." **Jordan Mason** (4.5) is in a three-back committee and is the likeliest MIN back to be traded (Heath). **LaPorta** (7.25) is a unanimous buy and gets MIA next week, so keep starting him. **Hampton** (6.95) was "third on the team in snap share." Keon Coleman (bench, 1.4) missed a wide-open deep TD. *Mine:* Mahomes scored 39.9 on your bench; the show noted he's been the best QB against DEN this year.
- **Sleeper DYNASTY (Amon A Boat!): you beat Freddy 132.38 to 125.54.** Santos kicks tonight, but Freddy has nobody left. You own **both Jets backs**. Braelon (23.3) won it for you, and Heath expects a heavy split with Breece if Breece isn't traded. **Hockenson 15.8 and Keenan Allen 13.7 outscored Tyler Warren 5.8 again from your bench.** Dave likes Hockenson as a starter, and the panel would only start Taylor if Richardson takes over in Indy. **Ken Walker** (12.4): "no concerns," with NYJ, ATL, ARI, BUF next. **Bowers** (28.2): Adam floated selling before a Mendoza switch, and the others pushed back, so hold. **Malik Willis** (bench, 14.64) is a named streamer. Caleb Douglas (8.3) is getting six targets. Lawrence 19.4 came on just 14 attempts.
- **Yahoo HE-MAN'S HEROES (The Cook King Show)** *(10/25 roster)*: **Derrick Henry** is the worry: Heath and others are "really worried," and BAL has no QB on a short week vs JAX. **Mahomes** was the top QB against DEN; keep him. **Swift and Odunze are on MNF tonight.** McConkey (bench) got bailed out by a lucky 54-yarder. Jacobs had the big week Heath predicted. Ollie Gordon has the same no-targets problem. Baker Mayfield (bench) threw three passes and completed none. Jordyn Tyson (IR) could be back as soon as Week 9 (from the morning show).
- **Yahoo SUPERFLEX (Jackson My Penix)** *(10/25 roster)*: **Penix (2.1, four INTs, "could not hold the ball") and Mayfield (0 completions)** were both bad in the 16-0 game. The panel expects TB to keep running, with CHI and DET next. QB is your biggest Superflex hole: Willis (DYN only, not this league) and Minshew were named as streamers. Judkins (6.9) should rebound vs NO (Dave). Flournoy (bench, 13.1) is a waiver darling who played more snaps than Pickens, so consider him. Jefferson stays a "borderline number one, number two receiver." Waddle scored. Pitts 2.6. Lamar was on IR in the file and now needs surgery.
- **Freddy:** In **MAIN** (Flowers for Ms. Jackson, lost 102.00 to 146.95) he's hurt worst by this episode: **Lamar on IR, Flowers "probably not a starter,"** DK Metcalf a featured loser, Kelce's red-zone role keeps shrinking, and Bijan is a buy-low that won't come cheap (so don't overpay him for Bijan). His JAX DST (26.0) is the panel's league-winner stream for Week 9. In **DYN** (The Man in Jahmyr, lost to you) Fannin (23.4) is Heath's winner, but he left Emmett Johnson 27.3, DeMario Douglas 17.6 and Corum 13.3 on his bench. Bourne has a high ankle sprain, and Corum is "a very good flex."

- **Tyler Warren (bench TE):** Heath benched him for Strange before the news. **Inactive.**
- **Trevor Lawrence (bench QB):** loses to Dak and Cousins, beats Jameis and Stroud, a coin flip with Mahomes. (He already played in London; JAX lost 31-34.)
- **Aaron Rodgers (bench QB):** "I do not trust Aaron Rogers" (Heath). Shough is preferred; Adam would take Rodgers over Jameis.
- **Austin Ekeler (bench):** banged up and in Heath's Rico Dowdle tier. **Rico Dowdle (bench):** "not worth a flex," a possible goal-line role.
- **Quentin Johnston (bench):** Heath picked Johnston over Cyrus Allen, Royals and **Josh Cameron (also yours)** in non-PPR.
- **Amon-Ra St. Brown (bench):** only mentioned as sitting on Heath's bench (DET bye).
- **Caleb Douglas (taxi):** "Douglas" in a sit-two at 57:09 got benched, along with Bourne. It's *probably* Caleb Douglas, but not certain.
- **Breece Hall:** never mentioned by the hosts. *(Guru: inactive, per NFL.com.)*

**MAIN LEAGUE (Myles High Club):**
- **Omarion Hampton (RB):** a borderline RB2. Below Pierce and Pollard; above White; ≈ Kamara. "Ran two routes last week." **Both hosts would trade Hampton for Luther Burden.**
- **Keon Coleman (WR):** the main Adam-vs-Heath debate. Heath has him as a low-end WR3 (low-to-high 30s) and a drop candidate because **BUF has a bye next week**; Adam makes the case for him. *(DJ Moore was inactive.)*
- **Jalen Coker (W/R/T):** in Heath's PPR pick-twos (Coker + A.J. Brown; Zay + Coker). Lost to Jeanty and Pickens.
- **Xavier Worthy (W/R/T):** "could be a decent start" with Rice out (Adam). Over Ladd and Keenan (Heath); under Burden and Tate.

- **Patrick Mahomes (bench QB):** Maye > Mahomes; a coin flip vs Lawrence.
- **Kendre Miller (bench):** "all he did last week was score a touchdown. It was 10 carries for 30 yards." Behind Kamara. Heath said to drop Strange rather than Miller.
- **Makai Lemon (bench):** "we're not going to go with Lemon" (55:06).
- **Sam LaPorta (bench):** only mentioned as on Heath's bench (bye).
- **Stefon Diggs (bench):** as above.
